entries.src: Have you seen Kresnik? I'll take him down with my own hands! // He's definitely in here somewhere.

entries.jp: {col:04}クドラクとのけっちゃくを{n}{col:04}つけたいところだが、{page}{col:04}まず、このじょうきょうを{n}{col:04}なんとかしないとな。

entries.src: I'd like to settle things with Bloodbat, // but first, I need to do something about this situation.

entries.jp: {col:03}ワタシのあには{n}{col:03}ここに来ているのだろうか？{page}{col:03}もし見かけたら、{n}{col:03}よろしくたのむ。
entries.en: {col:03}I wonder if my older brother has come{n}{col:03}here?{page}{col:03}If you see him, please help him out.

entries.jp: ケツアルコアトルが{n}そんなことを会ってたのか。{page}このようなものをたよるとは、{n}なさけないおとうとだ。
entries.en: Quetza said that, did he?{page}Relying on the likes of you... What a{n}pathetic little brother.
entries.src: Quetza said that, did he? // Relying on the likes of you... What a pathetic little brother.

entries.jp: {col:03}オーディンさまを{n}{col:03}すくってほしい。{page}{col:03}あとでここをもういちど{n}{col:03}さがしてみてほしいのだ。
entries.en: {col:03}Please save Odin-sama.{page}{col:03}I'd like you to search this place once more{n}{col:03}later.
entries.src: Please save Odin-sama. // I'd like you to search this place once more later.

entries.jp: われは{name}・・・{n}よいはたらきであった。{page}われもともに、{n}さいごのたたかいへのぞもう。
entries.en: I am {name}... You have done well.{page}I too shall join you in the final battle.
entries.src: I am {name}... You have done well. // I too shall join you in the final battle.

entries.jp: {col:03}あらあらしきスサノオが、{n}{col:03}ここにねむっている。{page}{col:03}オマエにかれを{n}{col:03}すくいだせるかな。
entries.en: {col:03}The wild Boltar slumbers here.{page}{col:03}Can you rescue him, I wonder?
entries.src: The wild Boltar slumbers here. // Can you rescue him, I wonder?
...Here... ...Amon...

entries.jp: ウオオオオオオォ！{page}魔力がもどって{n}力がみなぎるようだ！
entries.en: Uoooooooh!{page}My magic is back... I'm overflowing with{n}power!
entries.src: Uoooooooh! // My magic is back... I'm overflowing with power!

entries.jp: {col:02}この世界をつくったものが、{n}{col:02}この先でまっているぞ。{page}{col:02}この{name}、{n}{col:02}よろこんで力をかそう。
entries.en: {col:02}The one who made this world awaits{n}{col:02}ahead.{page}{col:02}I, {name}, shall gladly lend you my{n}{col:02}strength.
entries.src: The one who made this world awaits ahead. // I, {name}, shall gladly lend you my strength.

entries.jp: さあ、まようことはない。{n}のこるはアズラエルだけだ。{page}いまからは{name}も{n}オマエのみかただ。
entries.en: Now, there's no need to hesitate. Only{n}Azrael remains.{page}From now on, {name} is on your side{n}too.
entries.src: Now, there's no need to hesitate. Only Azrael remains. // From now on, {name} is on your side too.

entries.jp: なーんか、きみの悪い{n}バショですねえ。{page}ささ、はやくだっしゅつ{n}してしまいましょう。
entries.en: My, what a creepy place this is.{page}Come now, let's hurry up and get out of{n}here.
entries.src: My, what a creepy place this is. // Come now, let's hurry up and get out of here.

entries.jp: われは{name}・・・{page}こんごともよろしく・・・
entries.en: I am {name}...{page}I look forward to our time together...
entries.src: I am {name}... // I look forward to our time together...

entries.jp: わたしは{name}よ！{page}こんごともよろしくね♥
entries.en: I'm {name}!{page}Let's get along from now on♥
entries.src: I'm {name}! // Let's get along from now on♥

entries.jp: {col:02}われは{name}・・・{page}{col:02}こんごともよろしく・・・

entries.jp: わたしは{name}よ！{page}こんごともよろしくね♥

entries.src: I'm {name}! // Let's get along from now on♥

entries.jp: {col:02}ぼくは{name}だ、{n}{col:02}よろしく！
entries.en: {col:02}I'm {name}. Nice to meet you!
entries.src: I'm {name}. Nice to meet you!

entries.jp: このオレを助け出すとは、{n}タダモノではなさそうだ。{page}さて、ひさしぶりに{n}ひとあばれしたいな。
entries.en: Rescuing me like that... you're no ordinary{n}guy.{page}Now then, I'd love to cut loose for the first{n}time in ages.
entries.src: Rescuing me like that... you're no ordinary guy. // Now then, I'd love to cut loose for the first time in ages.

entries.jp: {col:02}ああ、やっと助かった。{n}{col:02}ありがとう。{page}{col:02}お礼に、ボクでよければ{n}{col:02}力をかそう。
entries.en: {col:02}Ahh, I'm finally saved. Thank you.{page}{col:02}To repay you, I'll lend you my power, if{n}{col:02}you'll have me.
entries.src: Ahh, I'm finally saved. Thank you. // To repay you, I'll lend you my power, if you'll have me.

entries.jp: そんなにちいさいのに、{n}たいしたものだなオマエは。{page}かんぷくしたぞ。{n}オマエのナカマになろう。
entries.en: So small, and yet you're really{n}something.{page}I'm impressed. I'll join your party.
entries.src: So small, and yet you're really something. // I'm impressed. I'll join your party.

entries.jp: すばらしいせいせきを{n}のこしたあなたに、{page}このわたしからごほうびです。{n}ケイヤクをきょかしましょう。
entries.en: For achieving such splendid results,{page}here is a reward from me: I grant you a{n}contract.
entries.src: For achieving such splendid results, // here is a reward from me: I grant you a contract.

entries.jp: おまえのかつやくを{n}ワタシはずっと見ていたぞ。{page}その力をみとめて、{n}ナカマになってやろう。
entries.en: I've been watching your exploits all{n}along.{page}I acknowledge your power, so I'll join{n}you.
entries.src: I've been watching your exploits all along. // I acknowledge your power, so I'll join you.

entries.jp: あきらめずに{n}よくがんばりました。{page}このすばらしいけっかを{n}しゅくふくしましょう。
entries.en: You never gave up and did very well.{page}Allow me to bless this wonderful result.
entries.src: You never gave up and did very well. // Allow me to bless this wonderful result.

entries.jp: ほう・・・ただ小さいヤツと{n}おもっていたが、{page}なかなかやるようだな。{n}・・・よかろう。力をかすぞ。
entries.en: Oh ho... I took you for just some little{n}runt,{page}but you're pretty good. ...Very well. I'll lend{n}you my power.
entries.src: Oh ho... I took you for just some little runt, // but you're pretty good. ...Very well. I'll lend you my power.

entries.jp: よくがんばったホー！{n}こっちまでうれしくなるホー！{page}きょうからキミは、{n}ボクらのナカマだホー。
entries.en: Great job-ho! It makes me happy too-ho!{page}Starting today, you're one of us-ho.
entries.src: Great job-ho! It makes me happy too-ho! // Starting today, you're one of us-ho.

entries.jp: よくがんばったホー！{n}キミはかがやいてるホー！{page}ほうびに、ワタシのことを{n}いろいろおしえてやるホー！
entries.en: Great job-ho! You're shining-ho!{page}As a reward, I'll tell you all about me-ho!
entries.src: Great job-ho! You're shining-ho! // As a reward, I'll tell you all about me-ho!

entries.jp: まよったかなー{n}ちっとも出られねえぞー！{page}お、オマエについていけば{n}ここから出られそうだな！
entries.en: Am I lost? I can't get out at all!{page}Oh, if I follow you, looks like I can get out{n}of here!
entries.src: Am I lost? I can't get out at all! // Oh, if I follow you, looks like I can get out of here!

entries.jp: こんなとこくるなんて、{n}ものずきなヤツだなあ。{page}でも気にいったぜ！{n}オレとたのしくやろうや。
entries.en: Coming to a place like this... you're a real{n}oddball.{page}But I like ya! Let's have some fun{n}together.
entries.src: Coming to a place like this... you're a real oddball. // But I like ya! Let's have some fun together.

entries.jp: オマエ、アタマ　ワルソウ{n}ダケド、ホントハ　スゴイヤツ{page}ソウユウヤツ　スキダゾ{n}ナカマニ　ナッテヤロウ
entries.en: You... look dumb. But really... amazing one.{page}Me like that kind. Me join you.
entries.src: You... look dumb. But really... amazing one. // Me like that kind. Me join you.

entries.jp: オマエカラ{n}ウマソウナ　ニオイスル・・・{page}タノム！ナカマニ　シテクレ{n}アトデ・・・グフフフフ
entries.en: You... smell... tasty...{page}Please! Let me join! Later... gufufufu...
entries.src: You... smell... tasty... // Please! Let me join! Later... gufufufu...

entries.jp: ココヲ　クリアスルトハ{n}ナカナカノ　モノダ{page}キミノチカラヲ　ミトメヨウ
entries.en: You... clear this place... Impressive.{page}Your power... I recognize it.
entries.src: You... clear this place... Impressive. // Your power... I recognize it.

entries.jp: フム、ミゴトなかつやくだ。{page}オマエとなら{n}くんでやってもいいぞ。
entries.en: Hmm, splendid work.{page}With you, I wouldn't mind teaming up.
entries.src: Hmm, splendid work. // With you, I wouldn't mind teaming up.

entries.jp: うーん、むずかしい{n}めいきゅうだ・・・{page}ボクはもうこうさんする。{n}キミについていくよ。
entries.en: Hmm, what a tough maze...{page}I give up. I'll follow you.
entries.src: Hmm, what a tough maze... // I give up. I'll follow you.

entries.jp: ここで知りあったのも、{n}きっとなにかのエンだな。{page}よし、きめたぞ！{n}今からキミのナカマになる。
entries.en: Meeting here must be some kind of fate.{page}All right, I've decided! I'm joining your party{n}starting now.
entries.src: Meeting here must be some kind of fate. // All right, I've decided! I'm joining your party starting now.

entries.jp: よお、ひさしぶり。{n}元気にしてたか？{page}オレもナカマになるぜ！
entries.en: Yo, long time no see. You doing okay?{page}I'm joining your party too!
entries.src: Yo, long time no see. You doing okay? // I'm joining your party too!

entries.jp: ひさしぶりだね！{n}ちゃんとおぼえててくれてる？{page}ワタシもナカマにいれてね。
entries.en: Long time no see! You still remember me,{n}right?{page}Let me join your party too.
entries.src: Long time no see! You still remember me, right? // Let me join your party too.
